description:
Hi,

I hope you are doing good.

I have a job opportunity related to your profile with one of our client, please find below Job Description for your review. If you are interested and available for the following position then please send your updated resume in word format along with your contact details to discuss further.

(Interview will be On 12th May 2017 and offers will be rolled out quickly)

 Role: Technology Analyst – O365 Administration (One Drive and SharePoint online)
Duration: Full TIme
Location: Cypress, TX


Skills & Experience
Required 

• Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent required from an accredited institution. Will also consider three years of progressive experience in the specialty in lieu of every year of education
• At least 2 years of experience with Information Technology.

 Preferred 

•At least 2 years of technical experience 
•At least 2 years of working directly with Microsoft Office 365
•At least 1 year of extensive knowledge and experience of deploying, managing, and supporting Office 365, especially OneDrive for Business and SharePoint 
•Experience with on premise to SharePoint online 
•Implement, administer, maintain, and troubleshoot issues regarding on premise Exchange servers, Exchange Online, secure email gateways, and ADFS. 
•Architecture & deployment experience with Exchange 2010/2013 including mailbox and public folder environment. 
•Experience with end user mailbox troubleshooting and creation.
•Troubleshooting knowledge on mail flow and third party spam firewall like Proof point, trend micro, etc. 
 •Experience in configuring/deploying ADFS 
 •Experience with Microsoft instant messaging platform (Lync / Skype for Analytical and Communication skills)


 • Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent required from an accredited institution. Will also consider three years of progressive experience in the specialty in lieu of every year of education


 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
